summary: Module 09 BUILD: Implemented full integration test suite testing redirect correctness (GET /r/<code> redirecting to long URL), auth protection (returns 401 on missing/invalid token), owner scoping IDOR protection (A's link cannot be accessed by B, returns 404), retention enforcement (purge_old_clicks deletes click events older than retention_days settings while retaining newer clicks), and URL validation (rejects invalid/abuse schemas like javascript: or open redirect bypasses like http%3A%2F%2Fevil.example.com). Also explained why flaky tests destroy team trust and productivity. Checked test suite using pytest, with all 71 tests passing.
evidence: Verified tests/test_auth.py has test_owner_cannot_see_others_link and test_links_requires_auth.
Verified tests/test_link_validation.py parametrizes ABUSE_URLS containing bypass strings like http%3A%2F%2Fevil.example.com.
